Project and code rescue

We take over a project the previous team abandoned or could not finish, stabilise it and see it through. An MVP in 2–4 weeks, from UZS 36 mln; the full version in 8–20 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Access and code handover
  • Audit of code, infrastructure and security
  • List of critical fixes
  • Production stabilised
  • An honest verdict: fix or rewrite
What the full version adds
  • Fixes and refactoring
  • Tests
  • Documentation

  • A maintainable setup
  • Then regular support

  • The project's code and documents

Questions

What does “Project and code rescue” cost?
The MVP costs $3,000–8,000 (UZS 36–97 mln), the full version $12,000–50,000 (UZS 144–605 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Project and code rescue” take?
The MVP takes 2–4 weeks, the full version 8–20 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
The project's code and documents, access rights, a contact person.
